Due dates

Property tax due Feb 1, May 1, Aug 1, Nov 1; 10-day grace period (must be received by the 10th).. See the official page.

Census respondents put the median owner-occupied home in Old Bridge at $457,800, 12% above the nj median for these places. Renters live in about 26% of Old Bridge homes, and owners in 74%, where the nj median is 44% owners. A median build year of 1967 puts the typical Old Bridge house near 56 years old. These numbers describe Old Bridge as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
